assets.prompt: Edit image 1, the current isolated illustration of Denia's bubble staff. Image 2 is a visual reference for the staff identity and overall original character palette. Important user correction: the entire shaft from its left tip to the round head is a perfectly straight, plain unbroken pole. The midpoint currently has bulbous segmented metal decorations, collars, and a raised knot. ERASE ALL of them. Render the shaft as a single ruler-straight slender cylindrical rod with two perfectly parallel long edges, constant narrow diameter, smooth uninterrupted pale mauve-silver surface and one continuous lengthwise highlight, absolutely no breaks, knuckles, beads, rings, collars, screws, knots, diamond segments or joints anywhere along it. Leave the entire rod clearly visible across at least sixty percent of the image. Make the left tip a simple rounded end. Connect it cleanly directly to the outside of the round head; keep ornament, if any, strictly inside the rightmost head silhouette: no ribbon or bow wrapped around the shaft anywhere. Preserve the recognizable open silver crescent that cradles a rainbow bubble at upper right, its shape and hand-painted anime style, with two small soap bubbles floating by the head. Wide oblique composition from bottom left to upper right, isolated cutout in genuine alpha transparency; no person, text or background. The slender straight shaft is the central subject of the correction; keep it as simple as an unbroken conductor's baton.

assets.prompt: Create an original hand-inked, gouache-colored anime game artbook spot illustration, with readable large silhouettes, selective edge light, supple varying line weights. No people, hands, text or logos, genuinely transparent background, no opaque wash outside the object. Wide horizontal canvas, entire subject clearly in frame, attractive at a small printed size. Draw ONLY the floating halo directly above Denia's head in both references, with a small accompanying star chart. Near the right side a slender orbital sigil, tilted slightly upward to the right: dark round eclipse disk, a very clear pearly FOUR-POINT star in its center, thin warm pink-gold and cyan rims around the vertical circular disk. From BOTH sides of the disk extend very long sweeping pointed crescent-like blue metal wings so the overall silhouette is an elongated eye, width 4 times the diameter of the disk. This is not a tiara on a person; it floats by itself. To its left and slightly below, connect five or six distinct pale blue pinprick stars using extremely fine broken silver lines to make one small legible angular branched constellation diagram which visually leads into the halo. Rich midnight blue, electric cyan, drops of violet and rosy warm light. Keep design simple enough to recognize on dark plum paper. No ice crystals, gemstone shards, planets, cubic objects or large surrounding background.
assets.reference: User-supplied dark Denia screenshots (eye-shaped halo and four-point star).
